correctness.rationale: Inclusion-exclusion over at most one nonzero row type gives exact rank probability. The q-derivative has fixed sign and endpoint failure branches have strict signs with unique common optimum at p=2/3. The strong law gives a 2x2 Gram matrix with eigenvalues p±q; its sharp E-optimal coefficient is attained only p=1/2,q=0. Exact-rational multinomial enumeration verifies 210 finite cases and benchmarks; infinite statements are analytic.

value.rationale: The exact finite-n design picks uniform distribution on three nonzero directions with exponentially smaller rank-deficiency chance than independent rounding at the same entry mean, while the sharp asymptotic smallest-singular-value design instead uses two orthogonal directions. These are distinct natural numerical-regularization objectives for a rank-deficient input directly motivated by a published stochastic-rounding study. Neither finite exact optimization nor conflicting numerical-conditioning optimum follows just from correctness or reproducibility. The conflicting global optima vary the input fractional level p; for each fixed input p both criteria select the same maximal anticorrelation, a scope restriction stated in the result.
